title: model2data dashboard 0.1.0
description: A dashboard over a model2data model's metrics and columns: a `<name>.dashboard.yml` file. It names metrics, `table.column` dimensions and tables, never a data source or a value. Normative together with README.md in this directory, which says what each tile shows and the checks a reader makes beyond this schema (unique ids among others). Where a field is text, a number is read as its text (`title: 2024` is the title "2024"); an optional field that is null is read as left out.

model2data-dashboard.description: The version of the dashboard spec the file is written against. A reader refuses a minor version it does not implement (the spec is before 1.0.0).

model.description: The `name` of the model the dashboard is for. A reader that checks the file against a model of another name warns.

title.description: The dashboard's title for people. The file name, not the title, is the dashboard's name.

pages.description: The pages, in the order they are shown.

optionalName.description: Text of at most 200 characters, or null for none.

grain.description: The period a value over time is computed per.

page.description: One page of tiles on a grid 12 columns wide.

id.description: The page's id: unique among the file's pages, and kept when the page is edited, since links and comments anchor on it.

grain.description: What the page's tiles over time are on; `month` when left out. A tile's own `grain` overrides it.

place.description: Where a tile sits: column `x`, row `y`, `w` columns wide, `h` rows high. Keep `x + w` at most 12.

x.description: The column the tile starts in.

y.description: The row the tile starts on.

tile.description: One tile. `kind` says what it shows and which of the other fields it reads; README.md lists them per kind.

id.description: The tile's id: unique among every tile of the file, on every page, and kept when the tile is edited, since links and comments anchor on it.

comparison.description: `kpi`: text shown under the number. It is not computed.

compare.description: `kpi`: `previous` shows the last complete period against the one before it, on the tile's `grain` (else the page's).

grain.description: `line`, `stacked`, and `kpi` with `compare`: a grain of the tile's own, over the page's.

by.description: `bar`, `donut`: the dimension broken down by, `table.column`. `line`: one line per member of it. `stacked`: what each bar is stacked by.

across.description: `stacked`: a dimension, `table.column`, whose members are the bars instead of periods.

table.description: `table`: the table whose rows are shown, by its key in the model.

columns.description: `table`: the columns shown, by name; all of them when left out.

rows.description: `table`: how many rows are shown (10 when left out).
